title: Agent answer coverage
$comment: Written beside every agent artifact. It answers one question the artifact itself cannot: was this agent asked for less than the run asked it for, and if so what did it leave out. A run that cuts an output budget is deciding to leave work undone, and this file is where that decision is recorded so a stage can refuse to finish over it.

status.description: 'covered' means the artifact is the whole answer. 'deferred' means it is not, and every missing item is listed below.

requestedBytes.description: The output budget the run started this agent with. Zero means the agent was not given one.

grantedBytes.description: The budget the accepted answer was actually written against. Below requestedBytes means the run asked for less than it wanted.

reductions.description: Every time the budget was cut, and why. Empty is the ordinary case.

deferrals.description: Copied from the artifact so the record of what is missing survives independently of the document that is missing it.

deferralsSource.description: 'agent' means the entries below are the ones the artifact declared. 'run' means the artifact declared none although it was written under a reduced budget, and the run entered its whole assignment as one item rather than take the answer for finished. Absent means 'agent'.
